description: The compact 2004 block gives Pat and Mat five focused challenges: golf, a tiny lost object, digging a pool, hanging a landscape painting and rebuilding a troublesome Christmas tree.

s10e01.description: Pat and Mat try their hands at golf, but acquiring the correct setting and equipment is less appealing than adapting the space around them into a course of their own design.

s10e02.description: A small bottle cap disappears somewhere inaccessible, and the effort to retrieve it grows into a disproportionate investigation involving tools, furniture and the dismantling of whatever happens to be in the way.

s10e03.description: Pat and Mat decide the garden needs a swimming pool and begin digging, measuring and improvising the structure themselves rather than accepting the radical concept of buying something already finished.

s10e04.description: Mat brings home a landscape painting, and hanging it neatly behind the sofa becomes an extended exercise in positioning, measuring, hammering and disguising the evidence of earlier attempts.

s10e05.description: A large Christmas tree arrives with an awkward asymmetry. Pat and Mat trim, brace and rebuild it until decorating the tree becomes secondary to keeping their increasingly modified creation upright.
